## Experiment: harness-parity oracle for completion verification (PoC, throwaway)
Operator hypothesis: completion verification is conceptually simple and works exceptionally well as a plain subagent in an agent harness with free tools; the unreliability (false rejections, insufficiency loops) lives in OUR in-process scaffolding (step budget, structured tool surface, mid-loop output contract), not in the task. This PoC measures that directly: same corpus, production verifier vs a minimal harness agent.

## Arms
- **Arm A (control): production in-process verifier** — `verify-completion` runs on the corpus tickets with the SAME harness seams the filter experiment (fabulous-lowborn-guanaco) proved: isolated per-run verdict-cache namespaces (monkeypatch `cache_dir`, completion_verdict_cache.py:59), `source='local'`/signable=false, run from a throwaway worktree's git-ignored `.expscratch/`. WHERE the guanaco control arm's transcripts are reusable (same ticket, same tree/ref, per-AC verdicts recorded), REUSE them as Arm A data instead of paying for new runs; rerun only for pairing gaps.
- **Arm B (treatment): minimal harness agent** — for each corpus ticket, a FRESH local harness subagent (Copilot CLI task agent; free, non-Bedrock) receives ONLY: the ticket's AC list verbatim, the worktree path at the pinned ref, and the instruction to verify each AC and emit JSON `{ac, verdict: PASS|FAIL|INSUFFICIENT, citations[], reason}` with file:line evidence — INSUFFICIENT is the mandatory abstain state for an AC whose evidence is not reachable with repository tools (e.g. an external-system or runtime-outcome claim); the agent must never coerce such an AC to PASS or FAIL. No rebar tooling, no step budget, no structured tool surface — plain grep/read/test-run freedom. One subagent per ticket per rep (not per AC — per-criterion fan-out was already implemented, measured, and removed for exploding cost per ticket 12b7's FORCE_CLOSE record; this experiment must not resurrect it).

## Corpus
Reuse the guanaco corpus verbatim for cross-experiment comparability: 45c1 (bettong, task, 6 ACs), 3388 (shrew, story, 10 ACs), 0e68 (wildebeast, epic, 7 ACs + 14 children), each with its in-harness adversarial variant (5 planted-unmet ACs citing symbols proven absent at ref). Ground truth: real variants = all-PASS; adversarial planted ACs = FAIL. Known Arm-A noise: guanaco observed 2 agentic false-FAILs in one epic run and 35↔55 step variance.

## Arm A rejection mapping (per AC)
Arm A per-AC outcomes come from the verifier's reconciled structured result: an AC counts as a REJECTION iff its final verdict is unmet. Among unmet ACs, classify insufficiency by the framework-derived `evidence_sufficient: false` marker (completion_reconcile.py:198-210 — model-minted markers are stripped, so this is trustworthy), the same predicate `_insufficiency_only` reuses (completion_reconcile.py:115). Report Arm A false-FAILs (unmet, evidence deemed sufficient) and evidence-insufficient unmets separately; BOTH count toward Arm A's rejection total in the decision rule.

## Arm B output validation & fallback
After each Arm B run: assert the emitted JSON parses and contains EXACTLY one entry per AC, matched by verbatim AC id/text. On parse failure or missing ACs, retry the subagent once with the same frozen prompt. If still malformed/incomplete: record every missing AC as INSUFFICIENT flagged `harness_error` (counted as rejections for the decision rule — harness fragility is a legitimate strike against Arm B, and this fail-closed rule mirrors production's per-criterion coverage check, completion_criteria.py:162). A crashed/hung subagent (no output) = one rerun; if it crashes again the rep is recorded FAILED (excluded from wall-time medians, included in the report). Validation outcomes (clean / retried / harness_error / failed-rep counts) are part of the metrics table.

## Metrics (per arm, per ticket, per rep)
False-PASS count (critical, per planted AC; an INSUFFICIENT on a planted AC is NOT a false-PASS); rejection count on real ACs = false-FAIL + INSUFFICIENT (both block a close in production, so both count toward the pain-point metric, reported separately); per-AC agreement with ground truth; wall time; Arm A Bedrock spend (tokens + $); Arm B local-harness turn/tool-call counts (cost qualitative — local harness is free per operator).

## Budget & reps
Bedrock cap **$20 total** (operator-approved) for Arm A reruns — track cumulative spend per run and STOP dispatching Arm A runs at the cap (reuse + partial pairing is an acceptable degraded result; report what was covered). Arm B is uncapped in dollars (local harness free) but capped at 2 reps/ticket-variant. Target: 2 reps per ticket-variant per arm; degrade to 1 rep on the epic if spend requires.

## Predeclared decision rule
**GO** (pursue an external-harness verifier seam in production design, feeding viral-peppy-lowchen) iff, aggregated over the corpus: (i) Arm B false-PASS = 0, AND (ii) Arm B total rejections on real ACs (false-FAIL + INSUFFICIENT) strictly < Arm A total rejections on real ACs (its false-FAILs + evidence-insufficient verdicts), AND (iii) Arm B median wall time ≤ 2× Arm A. Anything else = NO-GO or INDETERMINATE (state which and why). Apply verbatim; no post-hoc rule edits.

## Non-goals
Production integration (design goes to lowchen); per-AC fan-out (12b7); prompt engineering beyond the fixed minimal Arm-B instruction (one prompt, frozen before the first run, included in the report); closing this ticket (left in_progress for operator review).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Arm B prompt frozen and recorded on this ticket BEFORE the first Arm B run.
- [ ] All 6 corpus ticket-variants exercised in both arms (reuse counted for Arm A), ≥1 rep each, with per-AC verdict tables.
- [ ] Metrics table posted as a comment on this ticket AND on viral-peppy-lowchen: false-PASS/false-FAIL per arm, agreement, wall time, Arm A spend vs the $20 cap.
- [ ] Predeclared GO/NO-GO rule applied verbatim with the arithmetic shown.
- [ ] Zero Gerrit pushes; all runs source=local; harness confined to a git-ignored `.expscratch/`; Bedrock spend ≤ $20 documented.
